The '''LSS 1000 Mark V''' [[Stuncuffs/Legends|Stun cuffs]] were a pair of handcuffs used to subdue prisoners. They were known as a more sophisticated version of the [[LSS 1000 Automatic Stun Cuffs]].<ref name="legacy38">[[Legacy (2006) 38|''Legacy'' (2006) 38]] </ref> 

In [[137 ABY]], [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Gunn Yage]] apprehended the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Cade Skywalker]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and bound him with an LSS 1000 Mark V stun cuffs.<ref name="legacy38" />
